mapper.sql: id, purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, token_hash AS tokenHash, token_prefix AS tokenPrefix, expires_at AS expiresAt, revoked_at AS revokedAt, last_used_at AS lastUsedAt, use_count AS useCount, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_purchase_share_token SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_purchase_share_token (token_hash, token_prefix, purchase_order_id, expires_at, created_by) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM xsy_purchase_share_token WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_purchase_share_feedback (share_token_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_item_id, unit_price, received_quantity, remark, operator_ip, created_by) VALUES (#{shareTokenId}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseOrderItemId}, #{unitPrice}, #{receivedQuantity}, #{remark}, #{operatorIp}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierName, e.actual_name AS purchaserName, o.warehouse_name_snapshot AS warehouseName, o.planned_arrival_date AS plannedArrivalDate, o.status AS status FROM xsy_purchase_order o LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = o.purchaser_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE o.id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND o.deleted = FALSE

SELECT i.id AS itemId, i.product_name_snapshot AS productName, i.sku_name_snapshot AS skuName, i.purchase_unit_snapshot AS purchaseUnit, i.planned_quantity AS plannedQuantity, i.received_quantity AS receivedQuantity, i.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, f.unit_price AS lastUnitPrice, f.received_quantity AS lastReceivedQuantity, f.remark AS lastRemark, f.submitted_at AS lastSubmittedAt FROM xsy_purchase_order_item i LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT unit_price, received_quantity, remark, submitted_at FROM xsy_purchase_share_feedback WHERE purchase_order_item_id = i.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) f ON TRUE WHERE i.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id
SELECT id FROM xsy_purchase_order_item WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND deleted = FALSE
